EC1: Patients will [NOT] not be included in the study if one or more of the following criteria
EC5: - Patient with recent (< 1 week) gastrointestinal disorders with diarrhea as major symptom
EC6: - Patient with any serious active infection
EC7: - Patient who has any other life-threatening illness [OR] or organ system dysfunction, which in the opinion of the investigator would either compromise patient safety or interfere with the evaluation of the test radiopharmaceutical
EC8: - Patient who [NOT] cannot communicate reliably with the investigator
EC9: - Patient who is unlikely to cooperate with the requirements of the study
EC10: - Patient who is unwilling [OR] and/or unable to give informed consent
EC11: - Patient at increased risk of death from a pre-existing concurrent illness
EC12: - Patient who participated already in this study.
